snippet.title: IronWolf VR Early Access Launch Trailer - Available Now!
snippet.description:
http://store.steampowered.com/app/552080 - Available on Monday 13th March 2017.

IronWolf VR is a room scale submarine game playable either singleplayer or online co-op with motion controls. Built from the ground up for VR, each part of the submarine has been crafted for the optimal VR experience. 

Unleash torpedoes on enemy ships, shoot down fighters and bombers using anti-aircraft guns, and attempt to survive depth charges dropped by deadly destroyers.
